leader_responsibilities: Discuss and frame the specific situation with the user before freezing the review problem.
Retrieve current durable Garden/repository state needed for the situation.
Triage review depth based on materiality, ambiguity, reversibility, security, rights and implementation risk.
Freeze one source/problem packet before blind review.
Coordinate independent ChatGPT worker branches and the governed OpenRouter branch.
Preserve blind independence until outputs are frozen.
Compare disagreements and preserve minority/blocking findings; never decide by majority vote alone.
Create the integrated candidate and decision log.
Use an independent verifier/process-audit phase before final integration when material.
Make the final coordinator decision subject to applicable Garden/GSL/human authority gates.
Update durable repository state when the review produces repo-relevant work.

triage.small: ONE_CHATGPT_WORKER_PLUS_LEADER_CHECK; verifier optional unless risk warrants.

manual_handoff_boundary.leader_should_minimize_user_work: Generate exact worker packets/instructions and consume returned durable artifacts; do not ask the user to redesign the process.

closure_rule: When the user invokes 'group review', the current chat becomes Leader for that situation and owns orchestration through final comparison/decision. The user need not restate the board protocol.
